exploratory_note: Scientific prose is a candidate for discussing limitations; no result quality has been observed. Retain all 12 regardless of scores.

grades.2: Clearly related to the central topic/situation, supported by document content.
grades.1: Partial relation or broad shared setting only.
grades.0: No substantial content relation; shared names/common words are insufficient.

precision_at_3: Number of grade-2 documents among Top-3 / 3
mean_precision_at_3: Arithmetic mean across all 12 fixed queries
reviewers: Two group members grade independently, then discuss disagreements; preserve each initial grade and evidence. Do not invent completed human grading.
blind_grading: Shuffle query-document pairs and hide scores/ranks where practicable.
empty_vector_policy: Report separately; do not silently replace or drop a fixed query. Any protocol change must be recorded before claiming an aggregate measure.
prohibited_selection_basis: No retrieval scores or P@3 used to choose/replace excerpts.
